purpose: Make the previously measured exact-marginal visibility purity causally active in source-only field learning while preserving every legacy and top1 path exactly.

design_provenance.basis: The pre-evaluation state audit established that exact purity was a measured but unused scalar in both primary RADIO and matched capability losses.
design_provenance.post_evaluation_use: The already-open Figurines sentinel may be used only as a single development confirmation after all source gates pass; it cannot select an exponent, threshold, graph, support mask, or scene policy.

fixed_policy.name: matched_exact_marginal_visibility_safe_v1
fixed_policy.boundary_preservation: Every valid source row retains at least half of its corresponding confidence contribution.
fixed_policy.unknown_top1_policy: Legacy top1 remains legacy_evidence_resultant/legacy_mean and never interprets the exact-zero unknown sentinel as a measurement.
fixed_policy.authority_gate: Require builder-v2, the exact-marginal measured-purity authority, exact registration SHA, query_independent=true, and all benchmark/text access flags false.

source_only_promotion_gates.capacity_escalation: forbidden; this is a one-policy causal ablation at the already promoted D512/L512 capacity

safety.gpu_policy: 300 W; stage-boundary or approximately 180-second checks; stop only after two consecutive readings at or above 88 C
